headline: Microsoft revamps Copilot app and drops Copilot+ PC branding from new laptops
summary: Microsoft unveiled a redesigned Copilot 'super app' combining chat, coding and agents in one interface, with support for third-party frontier models, while renaming its Scout assistant Autopilot; pricing details are still evolving. Separately, coverage reports Microsoft's newest Surface laptops no longer carry the 'Copilot+ PC' branding despite meeting its hardware requirements, with other new AI devices like the Nvidia RTX Spark and Project Zenith also missing the label.
